subject: reusable water bottle
title: What If You Never Washed Your Water Bottle?

scenes.text: What if you never washed your water bottle? It's only ever held water, right?
Every sip washes your mouth's bacteria back inside, and a damp bottle lets them multiply within hours.
Purdue researchers tested 90 bottles in daily use. Seven in ten held more than 100 bacteria in every milliliter.
Almost one in four also had coliform bacteria above the limit set for bottled water.
The worst lids, with spouts and seals, trap a slimy film you can't rinse away.
Hot soapy water and a brush, every day, clears most of it. Water was never the problem. You were.

description:
What if you never washed your reusable water bottle? A peer-reviewed study of 90 bottles in daily use found most held more than 100 bacteria per milliliter, and almost a quarter had coliforms above the bottled-water limit.
The bacteria come from your own mouth, and lids with spouts and seals are the hardest to clean.
